title: Returning Owner Storage Courtesy in Repair Estimates & Appointments Loyalty Terms
content:
**Term.** A returning owner's tenure lengthens the free storage period of a Repair Estimates & Appointments storage statement. The tenure is read from the owner's Workmanship Warranties coverages — a network workmanship warranty in active status and the date it was issued:

- an owner holding an active network workmanship warranty issued at least **24** whole months before the statement date adds **2** free storage days;
- an owner whose active network workmanship warranty was issued fewer than **24** whole months before the statement date adds **1**;
- an owner holding no active network workmanship warranty adds none.

| Owner's Workmanship Warranties record at the statement date | Free storage days added |
|---|---|
| Active warranty issued 24 or more whole months before | 2 |
| Active warranty issued fewer than 24 whole months before | 1 |
| No active warranty (none ever issued, or none still active) | none |

**Applying the term** (hypothetical owners)

- An owner whose active Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty was issued 30 whole months before the statement date adds 2 free storage days.
- An owner whose active warranty was issued 23 whole months before adds 1; had it been issued exactly 24 whole months before, the owner would add 2, since 24 is "at least 24".
- An owner whose only warranty has expired holds no active warranty and adds none.
